lead_html: Three CANDIDATE designs for the v1 FlowWorks fountain (item FOUNTAIN_LOOP_BUILD_PUMPS_ITS_OWN_RAIN), drawn playing, at true scale beside a vanilla human on 1x1 footprints. Pale stone: the game tints it by the stuff it is built from. Water leaves the basin through the front spillway; the ground water and ditch are drawn by the overflow layer in game. Pick one design (row note); nothing is installed.
